detailed_description: Age Calculator provides precise age calculations in years, months, and days. Beyond basic age calculation, it shows total days lived, weeks, months, and hours. It also calculates how many days until your next birthday, making it perfect for birthday countdowns and age verification.
usage_steps: Optionally change the reference date (defaults to today)
View your exact age in years, months, and days
See total days, weeks, months, and hours lived
Check days until your next birthday
usage_examples: Calculate exact age for official documents
Find out how many days until your next birthday
Calculate age difference between two dates
